1: // Game: Starfall Dodger
2: // Implements an endless runner on a canvas with id="game"
3: // Ship drifts down due to gravity; click/tap applies upward thrust.
4: // Random obstacles appear from the right; collision ends the game.
5: 
6: (function () {
7:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
8:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
9:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
10: 
11:   // Set canvas size to its displayed dimensions
12:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
13:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
14: 
15:   const GRAVITY = 0.3;      // pixels per frame²
16:   const THRUST = -6;        // instantaneous upward velocity
17:   const SHIP_W = 30;
18:   const SHIP_H = 30;
19:   const OBSTACLE_W = 40;
20:   const OBSTACLE_H = 40;
21:   const OBSTACLE_SPEED = 3;
22:   const SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms
23: 
24:   const ship = {
25:     x: canvas.width * 0.2,
26:     y: canvas.height / 2,
27:     vy: 0,
28:     w: SHIP_W,
29:     h: SHIP_H,
30:   };
31: 
32:   let obstacles = [];
33:   let lastSpawn = 0;
34:   let startTime = null;
35:   let score = 0;
36:   let running = true;
37: 
38:   // Input handling – mouse or touch
39:   const applyThrust = () => { ship.vy = THRUST; };
40:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', applyThrust);
41:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); applyThrust(); });
42: 
43:   // Game loop
44:   function update(timestamp) {
45:     if (!running) return;
46:     if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
47:     const delta = timestamp - (lastSpawn || timestamp);
48: 
49:     // Update ship physics
50:     ship.vy += GRAVITY;
51:     ship.y += ship.vy;
52: 
53:     // Lose if ship hits bottom or top
54:     if (ship.y + ship.h > canvas.height || ship.y < 0) {
55:       endGame();
56:       return;
57:     }
58: 
59:     // Spawn obstacles
60:     if (timestamp - lastSpawn > SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
61:       spawnObstacle();
62:       lastSpawn = timestamp;
63:     }
64: 
65:     // Update obstacles
66:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= OBSTACLE_SPEED);
67:     // Remove off‑screen obstacles
68:     obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.x + o.w > 0);
69: 
70:     // Collision detection (AABB)
71:     for (const o of obstacles) {
72:       if (rectIntersect(ship, o)) {
73:         endGame();
74:         return;
75:       }
76:     }
77: 
78:     // Update score (seconds survived)
79:     score = ((timestamp - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
80: 
81:     draw();
82:     requestAnimationFrame(update);
83:   }
84: 
85:   function spawnObstacle() {
86:     const y = Math.random() * (canvas.height - OBSTACLE_H);
87:     obstacles.push({ x: canvas.width, y, w: OBSTACLE_W, h: OBSTACLE_H });
88:   }
89: 
90:   function rectIntersect(a, b) {
91:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
92:   }
93: 
94:   function draw() {

113:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}s`, 10, 20);

117:     running = false;

120:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
